transcript: I went to India's biggest dream event for designers, and the world of design has officially changed forever. Figma did its first-ever annual event, Config, in India instead of San Francisco. I was invited to a special three-day creator cohort, and let me take you through the insane experience I had. It started in Bangalore at the iconic Taj Hotel, right after we had a seven-course dinner at the iconic place called Nila with my fellow creators, designers, and leaders. Then came the surprise magic act, a mind-blowing mentalist act to be precise. None of us really knew each other at first, but by the end of the night, we became such good buddies. The next day was even more fun: a Chittara art workshop in the morning, and in the night, a one-of-a-kind Asian cuisine experience in privately booked epic place called Koko. Then, I turned into high energy: DJ dance party, and oh man, people brought out their finest colors. Then came the main event on 15th. We got early access to the whole space, got a chance to check out the lovely merch. When the gates opened, we got a front-row access to the opening keynote by the CEO of Figma himself, and the crowd went wild. The energy in that auditorium was unreal. It had four major announcements for the day, and brought in some of the leading designers across the best companies in the world who shared their thoughts on design and AI. Figma launched code layers where you can turn a design into working interactive code right on the canvas. And they launched many more things, but more on that in my next video. And on top of that, there were goodies, gifts, and so many fun activities. Most of the year, we all live inside screens, but this week, it all became real. I came for Config, but I left with new friends. In my next video, I'll break down everything Figma launched and why it matters for you. Make sure to follow so you don't miss
caption:
Figma brought Config to India, and it turned into an experience I’ll never forget. 🥹✨
